property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner, calling setOwner(x) sets owner to the supplied address x in the reference contract; the mutant instead sets owner to tx.origin, so for some caller/tx.origin/address combinations the stored owner after the call will differ from the supplied x.
change_summary: Replace assignment to owner with assignment to tx.origin so setOwner can change owner to the externally-owned account that started the transaction instead of the immediate caller.
